text2: I mailed in for a coupon application to send seventy (70) total seals for a free carton of cigarettes.
text3: I smoked & supported the R. J. Reynolds Co. for thirty-two (32) years. I was a faithful user of your products all these years, until heart & lung disease ended my tobacco habit.
text4: I’m faithful to buy your products, the least your company could do, is back up its ad campaigns!!!
text5: I’m still waiting to send for my free carton of cigarettes, hope to hear from Reynolds soon.
text6: I also have at least twenty (20), or more, family members in my immediate family that are still smoking. There are four (4) smokers living in my home!
text7: Your company is still advertising the free cartons, but yet I’m still waiting to receive the one I requested months ago.
text8: Why do you advertise these types of things, then never follow through?!!
text9: Just as you, we could use a helping hand!
